BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. That Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit

District symbols as shown on Map Number 5-G in the area generally bounded by:

West Wisconsin Street; the public alley next east of and parallel to North Dayton Street; a
line 26.85 feet south of and parallel to West Wisconsin Street; and North Dayton Street

to those of an RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall take effect and be in force from and after its passage and
publication.

Common Address: 1875 North Dayton Street
